title: Ibu nke Onyinye A Jụrụ Ajụ
intro: N'oge mmalite akụkọ ihe mere eme mmadụ, mgbe ụwa ka dị obere ma ụwa wee kuo ume mbụ ya, otu mkpụrụ obi guzoro n'ihu Onye Okike na onyinye dị umeala n'obi. A tụrụ onyinye ahụ n'ọkwa nke nnabata Chineke - ma chọpụta na ọ dịghị mma. Ihe sochiri ya abụghị akụkọ mgbaghara, kama nke obi nke ekworo riri, nke dugara n'omume a na-apụghị ịgbanwe agbanwe nke ga-ada ụda ruo oge niile. Nke a bụ akụkọ nke onye aha ya ghọrọ otu ihe ahụ na ikpe na-ezighị ezi mbụ e mere.
clues: A mụrụ m dịka otu n'ime ụmụ mbụ a mụrụ, ndị mụrụ ha bụ nne ma ọ bụ nna ha maara akụkọ ya nke ọma.
E nwere mgbe m chụrụ àjà nye Allah, mana anabataghị m ya n'aka m — ọ bụ ezie na a nabatara onyinye nwanne m nwoke n'amara.
Anyaụfụ na iwe gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ n'obi m, m wee yie egwu na m ga-egbu ndị ikwu m.
Nwanne m nwoke dọrọ m aka ná ntị ka m tụọ egwu Allah, mana mpako m ekweghị ka m gee ntị.
N'oge adịghị ike dị egwu, emere m ihe a na-apụghị ịkọwa akọwa n'ahụ nwanne m nwoke.
Mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, amaghị m otu esi ezo ihe m mere — ruo mgbe e zigara anụ ọhịa nke ụwa ka ọ kụziere m ihe.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
